name: Minification benchmark: JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, SVG and XML minifiers on public files, with raw, gzip and brotli sizes and timings (FastMinify, edition 2026-10)
description: Citable edition: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23433365 (Zenodo, the reference for these files; this record is a copy). Measurements of 27 minifier settings on 2,669 public files under permissive licenses: 10 JavaScript, 6 CSS, 4 HTML, 6 JSON, 2,636 SVG and 7 XML files, taken from npm packages, from GitHub repositories at a fixed commit and from the WHATWG HTML review draft of July 2026. One row per file and setting (10,705 rows): the size before and after minification, raw, gzip (level 9) and brotli (quality 11), whether the output parses again, and the median time over repeated runs. One row records a tool error instead of a size. Tools: Terser, esbuild, SWC, oxc-minify and uglify-js for JavaScript; CSSO, Lightning CSS, esbuild, cssnano and clean-css for CSS; html-minifier-terser, minify-html and htmlnano for HTML; jq for JSON; SVGO for SVG; minify-xml and xmllint for XML. The minifiers of FastMinify, the code that runs on fastminify.com, are measured by the same script, one row per preset. Every setting is written out in the tools file. Measured on 2026-10-17 on one machine (Apple M4 Max, 64 GB, macOS 26.6.2, Node v26.4.0). Times depend on the machine and compare tools within this edition only. Sizes can be reproduced: the scripts, the pinned package versions and the input files are in the deposit, with the SHA-256 of every input and output.
